page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: running head "INDEX" centred at the top, then two parallel columns of Greek index entries, each line with its page and line reference, the left column ending in the right column's last line. A catchword sits at the foot of the right column. Right page, cut off at the right edge: a fragment of a second column of Greek index entries with page numbers 302, 303 beside it, plus a partly visible running head.
page.notes: Left page: the Greek index is in a sans-serif-like printed hand with many accents and breathings; accents and breathings in the Greek transcription are a best reading and some letters are doubtful, so several Greek words may contain errors. The right-hand fragment (page numbers 302, 303, and a partly visible "INDEX" running head at the top right edge) is cut off by the scan edge and is too damaged to transcribe reliably; it is not transcribed here. No page number is printed at head or foot of the left page.
